headline: President Obama created a White House Council on Women and Girls in 2009.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a council inside the White House focused on issues affecting women and girls. Only the title was available, so details about the council's members, duties, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and White House officials
who_it_affects.how: They were organized into a new council focused on issues affecting women and girls.
